reason: The cited evidence supports that laser cladding produces well-bonded, dense coatings (E2, E3) and that RHEA coatings on TC4 can have fine microstructures with intermetallics (E1). However, none of the cited passages provide data on hardness or wear resistance improvements, nor do they demonstrate that TC4's bulk properties are preserved after coating.
